candidate_name: Source Africa LNG — Dongo Kundu SEZ gas hub (FEGASUS floating gas/electricity supply unit + small-scale LNG-by-barge import)
sponsor_or_proposer: Source Africa LNG (SAL); partner Trans Gas Solutions; gas supplied by barge from Lindi/Mtwara, Tanzania
current_state: Reported (in secondary/aggregator summaries only) that SAL applied to the Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Authority to bring small-train natural gas by barge from Lindi/Mtwara, Tanzania, into the Dongo Kundu SEZ near Mombasa, and signed a 'private-sector-driven agreement' with Trans Gas Solutions to construct a 70,000 m3 LNG carrier and a 120,000 m3 Floating Electricity and Gas Supply Unit Station (FEGASUS). This would be a DISTINCT facility from the GEM 'Mombasa LNG Terminal' (T100000130254): different sponsor (SAL vs AMACO/Kenya MoE), different location (Dongo Kundu SEZ vs Mombasa Port), different concept (floating barge-fed supply unit vs onshore/floating regas import terminal). Dedup_index + grep confirm no Dongo Kundu / Source Africa / FEGASUS / Lamu record anywhere in GEM. Note: the separate KenGen 1,200 MW Dongo Kundu LNG-to-power plant (USD2.9bn; transaction advisers being sought as of Mar 2026) is in GEM's POWER tracker, out of LNG-terminals scope; Taifa Gas Dongo Kundu is an LPG terminal, out of scope.
